system.description:
Gripping an enemy and pouring your own dead energy into his limbs, you twist them into shrunken, decrepit ruin amid terrible pain.

Touch or strike the victim with a Physical Challenge, retested with Occult, and expend a Willpower Trait. The subject immediately gains the Negative Traits Clumsy and Lame as the useless limb shrivels, and suffers one health level of bashing damage on top of any from the blow; vampires heal this at the end of the night, but mortals are crippled permanently. By winning two successive Simple Tests after striking, you may target the head instead, killing mortals instantly and leaving vampires Oblivious and Witless and unable to use Celerity, Fortitude or Potence. Withering is not cumulative on the same limb, but successive strikes can afflict others.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.duration: Permanent on mortals; heals overnight for vampires
